# vercel_project_tracing (Resource)

Provides a Project Tracing resource.

Project Tracing sends OpenTelemetry traces from a project's deployments to Vercel. Ordered sampling rules can limit which traces are retained.

Deleting this resource disables tracing for the project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vercel_project_tracing" "example" {
  project_id = vercel_project.example.id

  sampling_rules = [{
    rate         = 0.2
    environment  = "production"
    request_path = "/api"
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Project to configure tracing for.

### Optional

- `sampling_rules` (Attributes List) Ordered head-sampling rules for traces. If omitted, all traces are retained. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sampling_rules))
- `team_id` (String) The ID of the team the Project exists under. Required when configuring a team resource if a default team has not been set in the provider.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--sampling_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sampling_rules`

Required:

- `rate` (Number) Sampling rate from 0 to 1.

Optional:

- `environment` (String) Environment to apply this sampling rule to. Can be `production` or `preview`.
- `request_path` (String) Request path prefix to apply this sampling rule to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Project Tracing can be imported by specifying the project ID.
terraform import vercel_project_tracing.example prj_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

# Alternatively, specify the team ID and project ID.
terraform import vercel_project_tracing.example team_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx/prj_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```
